article_summary: This article describes a photoredox-catalyzed protocol for the carbamoylation of alkenes using 4-carboxamido-Hantzsch esters as carbamoyl radical precursors. The reaction utilizes the organic dye 3DPAFIPN as a photocatalyst under visible light (455 nm) to generate nucleophilic carbamoyl radicals that add to electron-deficient and 1,1-disubstituted alkenes, providing access to functionalized carboxamides with 1,4-dicarbonyl motifs under mild conditions.
